question: What is the first name of the user who owns the greatest number of properties?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "users" AS SELECT "user_id" AS "user_id", "first_name" AS "first_name" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "properties" AS SELECT "property_id" AS "property_id", "owner_user_id" AS "owner_user_id" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH owner_counts AS (
  SELECT owner_user_id AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS property_count
  FROM properties
  GROUP BY owner_user_id
), top_owner AS (
  SELECT user_id, property_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY property_count DESC, user_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM owner_counts
)
SELECT u.first_name, t.property_count
FROM top_owner t
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.user_id
WHERE t.rn = 1;
